full_prompt_en: A square architectural photograph shows a solitary figure beneath a deep tunnel formed by thousands of staggered timber blocks, opening toward a bright garden. The camera looks from inside the shaded passage at about eye level. Along the ceiling and both side walls, short rectangular wooden pieces project at differing depths, forming a dense pixel-like field. Their underside is almost black near the camera but catches warm amber sunlight farther inside, making the repeated units more distinct toward the opening. The passage curves down along the left and right edges into a broad arch-like frame. The ground is an even brown paved surface, unbroken except for subtle seams and a few small dark specks. Beyond the tunnel, a triangular or irregular wedge of daylight reveals pale green trees and shrubs. On the right side of the opening, a cluster of low dark green planted mounds and a thin branching tree break the silhouette. Near the center-right, one small upright human figure stands in dark silhouette against the luminous outdoor background, giving the tunnel its large scale. Additional fine vertical lines near the opening may be slender branches or glazing supports, but they remain secondary to the block texture. Light enters from the far end and slightly left, raking across the lower rows of wood and leaving the upper near ceiling deep in shade. The warm brown structure contrasts with the cool misty greens outside; the apparent darkness of the foreground gradually gives way to brighter patterned wood and open air. No readable text appears. The overall composition is immersive and rhythmic, using a repeated three-dimensional grid, strong backlighting, and one tiny person to turn structural depth into a tactile journey.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形建筑摄影呈现一位孤身人物站在由成千上万错列木块构成的深长隧道下，通道向明亮花园敞开。相机从阴影中的通道内部、约平视高度向外望去。顶棚与两侧墙面上，短矩形木件以不同深度凸出，形成密集像素般色域。它们在近处顶面下几乎漆黑，向内接近出口处却受到暖琥珀色阳光照亮，使重复单元越来越清楚。通道沿左右边缘向下弯曲，构成宽阔拱形画框。地面是均匀棕色铺面，只有细微接缝和几处小暗点打断。隧道外一道三角形或不规则的日光开口露出浅绿色树木与灌木。开口右侧，一组低矮深绿植被土丘和一株细分枝树打断剪影。中央偏右附近，一位小小的人物以深色剪影站在发亮室外背景前，为隧道提供巨大尺度。开口附近还有细长竖线，可能是细枝或玻璃支撑件，但它们次于木块肌理。光从远端略偏左进入，掠过较低木排，让近处顶部深藏阴影。暖棕结构对照外面冷而带雾的绿色；前景深暗逐渐转向更明亮的花纹木材与开阔空气。没有可读文字。整体构图沉浸且有节奏，以重复三维网格、强烈逆光和一位极小的人，让结构纵深成为一段可触的旅程。
style_prompt_en: The photographic treatment turns repeated three-dimensional rectangular units into a continuous textured envelope. Warm brown faces alternate with nearly black recesses, and their staggered depth creates a granular pattern that becomes finer toward a bright opening. Strong backlight rakes selected protrusions and leaves the near interior in shadow, producing a gradual transition rather than an evenly lit surface. A broad dark surround frames a small pale area of cool green and gray, so value contrast carries the sense of passage. One tiny vertical accent within the opening establishes scale without interrupting the pattern. The ground stays comparatively calm and matte, giving the dense overhead rhythm visual relief. Edges of individual units remain hard, while the distant light and natural colors soften in haze. The overall effect is tactile, sheltering, and quietly dramatic, with repetition, depth, and controlled light defining the style.
style_prompt_zh: 这种摄影处理把重复的三维矩形单元变成连续有肌理的包围面。暖棕色正面与近黑凹处交替，错落深度形成颗粒图案，并向明亮开口逐渐收细。强逆光掠过有选择的凸起部分，让近处内部留在阴影里，形成渐进过渡，而非均匀照亮的表面。宽阔深色环绕框住一小片冷绿与灰色浅色区域，因此明度反差承担穿行感。开口里一点极小竖向重音建立尺度，却不打断图案。下部平面相比之下平静且哑光，给予头顶密集节奏视觉喘息。单个单元的边缘保持坚硬，远处光线与自然色则在雾中柔化。整体效果可触、带庇护感且安静富戏剧性，重复、纵深和有控制的光定义画风。
theme_en: A solitary figure beneath a tunnel of stacked timber blocks
theme_zh: 一位孤身人物站在层叠木块形成的隧道下
name: Kengo Kuma
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
